text: Saturday at dusk, they worked it out on the back of a ferry timetable.
Every light throws a shadow on its far side. Light something from every side at once, and there is no far side left.
The tower above. The under-lamp below. Twelve lanterns in a ring. Wren’s candle, Dunn’s harbour lamp, Marlo’s ferry lights.
And Gus’s lantern in the middle. As bait.
Wren asked who would stand in the middle when the dark came for its keeper.
Gus said that was the job. It always had been.
